title: AI Engineering Intern
lines: Found that RNNoise denoising was degrading ASR for an Egyptian Arabic voice agent and bypassed it on the STT path, cutting WER from 54.8% to 29.6% (60 clips including 8 kHz telephony).
Benchmarked five open-source Egyptian and code-switching ASR models at 16 kHz and simulated 8 kHz telephony, and wrote the STT, LLM and tashkeel selection decision records.
Built evaluation harnesses for ASR, LLM, TTS and code-switching: LLM-as-judge, an end-of-turn benchmark and live-audio re-scoring.
Built a dedicated vLLM ASR service and shipped RAG, tool calling and latency instrumentation on a four-person team (40 of 63 merged commits).

title: Network Infrastructure, AI & Automation Intern
lines: Built a RAG assistant over a 1,568-page Nokia hardware planning guide (structure-aware chunking, manual cosine search, cite-or-refuse prompt) that scored 8/8 on a fixed evaluation, including a correct refusal.
Built a four-screen Power Apps task manager on SharePoint with a Power Automate email-notification flow as the program capstone.

title: Cloud Engineering Intern
lines: Designed how a cloud-provisioning platform's Ansible engine would run on Kubernetes (Jobs, RBAC, Secrets, EFS volumes, templated manifests) and prototyped job creation with the Node client.
Built an HA RabbitMQ cluster with the operator and Kustomize overlays, plus Terraform modules for RDS and Amazon MQ.

Built a GitHub Actions to S3 to Auto Scaling deployment with a least-privilege IAM user, EFS and a private database behind a bastion TCP proxy, and benchmarked PostgreSQL dump formats on 1.5 GB (parallel restore about 3x faster).

title: Backend Engineering Intern
lines: Analyzed a legacy Node.js order controller (22 endpoints), found contradictory billing logic and redundant queries, and wrote endpoint-level test plans and logging improvements.

Designed and demoed a performance-monitoring tool (response time, TTFB, percentiles) with a 51-hour plan for dashboards and regional probes, and hypothesised the data layer as the main bottleneck (to be validated).

title: DevOps Intern
lines: Built an AWS staging environment (VPC, bastion nginx reverse proxy with HTTPS and basic auth, private Jenkins host) used by software, QA and pentest interns.
Delivered Jenkins CI/CD pipelines for the three apps of an internal AI product (React, Rails, Python): Docker Compose builds from the staging branch, health checks and per-build release directories.
Wrote Terraform for a three-AZ AWS network (S3 remote state, bastion, RDS subnets, security groups, modules) and Ansible roles for LAMP and LEMP stacks.
Diagnosed recurring staging outages from system and application logs (multi-gigabyte AI Docker images from Jenkins builds filling the disk) and added scheduled image cleanup; no further outages.
